decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset occurs from index 525 to 538, marked by coherent multi-axis excursions (N drop, E dip, U spike) followed by multi-sample recovery. A second candidate interval (539–552) shows correlated N/U step-down with flat E, but lacks a clear opposing return on N/U, rendering its status uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported within allowed context [450,699].

intervals.observation: N drops sharply (~+1.7 to -0.3), E dips (~+2.4 to +1.2), U spikes dramatically (~+9.6 to +11.9) over indices 525–530, then all three components show coherent multi-sample recovery toward pre-event levels through index 538; onset and return are multi-point and axis-coherent, satisfying temporary offset criteria.

N and U show a correlated step-down (~N: +11.1 to +9.2; U: +6.2 to +2.2) between indices 539–545, while E remains relatively flat (−10.4 to −10.5); however, the return is ambiguous—U recovers partially by index 552 but not fully to pre-539 level, and N shows no clear reversal; insufficient evidence for full return on affected axes.
